name: Muha Meds 510 Cartridge | Cali Gas OG
description: Cali Gas OG offers a unique flavor experience that combines fuel-like notes with a citrusy twist. The taste is characterized by a pungent and earthy flavor profile with hints of lemon and lime. This strain delivers a potent and uplifting high, providing an energizing and focused experience. Cali Gas OG is an excellent choice for those seeking a flavorful and invigorating cannabis strain.
